blocks.body:
The universal high-end measuring machine »﻿﻿﻿﻿»threadCheck« ❘ cc﻿﻿﻿﻿« from ZOLLER sets new standards for the fully automatic, comprehensive measurement of all types of cutting tools and specializes in threading and Gear cutting tools.

Intelligent multi-sensor technology and the functional full enclosure, combined with the universal tool-holding system including a Tailstock, make the ZOLLER »﻿﻿﻿﻿threadCheck ❘ cc﻿﻿﻿﻿« unique worldwide.

Request a 1:1 expert consultation now

Calibrating measuring machines on-site using certified test specimens and reference standards is an important part of E. ZOLLER GmbH & Co. KG’s quality assurance process—this ensures reliable measurement results and the high precision of your products in accordance with applicable standards.

items: Universal Multi-sensor Technology and Clamping Technology

spots.label: control cabinet
spots.text:
control cabinet

control cabinet

Control cabinet – with active ventilation. The electronic components are carefully and securely installed to ensure trouble-free operation. In addition, optimal ease of maintenance and service is guaranteed.

spots.label: incident light camera
spots.text:
incident light camera

Incident light camera with Multi-LED segment illumination and CNC swiveling device

Incident light camera with Multi-LED segment illumination and CNC swiveling device – for inspection and automatic measurement of tool geometries on the circumference, in the chip space, and on the end face. It is simple to enter the target parameters in the Measuring program dialog, and each measurement parameter is automatically measured and recorded: rake angle, radial relief angle, Groove contour, chamfer width, and many other geometries. The high-performance LEDs, segmented into eight areas, are automatically controlled by the measuring system and ensure optimal lighting of the surface through automatic intensity control—for high precision and repeatability.

spots.label: »orthoScan«
spots.text:
»orthoScan«

»orthoScan« Swivelling Multi-sensor Optic Carrier

»orthoScan« Swivelling Multi-sensor Optic Carrier – always finds the perfect perspective for the tool. This allows the cutting edge geometries of pitched tools, such as thread drills or hob cutters, to be measured via transmitted light without distortion.

spots.label: Sliding door
spots.text:
Sliding door

Space-saving and ergonomic sliding door

Space-saving and ergonomic sliding door—reliably keeps out external influences such as dirt or external light during measurement. The generous opening, even in the upper area, facilitates the loading and unloading of heavy tools using hoists or cranes.

spots.label: High-End Design
spots.text:
High-End Design

High-End Design

High-end design—with a solid-stone base serving as a high-precision platform for the measuring tower, spindle, and Tailstock.

spots.label: Safety Package
spots.text:
Safety Package

Safety Package

Safety Package – in which key control elements are mounted on the front of the measuring machine. This ensures you always have unobstructed access to the emergency stop switch, the reset button, the membrane keyboard, and the button for starting measuring processes.

spots.label: Vibration decoupling
spots.text:
Vibration decoupling

Vibration decoupling

Vibration decoupling—the integrated, active vibration damping system with automatic level control absorbs external vibration influences at the installation location.

spots.label: transmitted light camera
spots.text:
transmitted light camera

Transmitted light camera with Multi-LED illumination

Transmitted light camera with Multi-LED illumination—featuring high-quality, low distortion optics and telecentric transmitted light, it enables μm-accurate measurement of cutting edge contours and Step geometry in Silhouette mode with up to 5 Mpx. The camera features a high frame rate for fast focusing and contour scanning during Tool rotation. The Multi-LED ring light provides bright, high-contrast lighting for cutting edge inspection using incident light.

spots.label: Pneumatics tailstock
spots.text:
Pneumatics tailstock

Pneumatics tailstock

Pneumatics tailstock—with a high-precision rotating tip, it allows for the use of long, thin tools as a counter-tip as well as clamping between tips. The smooth-running quick-adjustment mechanism ensures precise positioning at the tool center, and the automatic pressure build-up guarantees secure tool holding without clamping force. Additionally, the integrated CNC drive enables automation for loading and clamping between tips.

spots.text:
»Cockpit« Control Unit

»Cockpit« Control Unit

»Cockpit« control unit – offers operators ergonomics and comfort through customizable adjustment options. The »cockpit« can be adjusted for height and position, and the 24-inch TFT color monitor can also be tilted.

spots.label: Software »Pilot 4.0«
spots.text:
Software »Pilot 4.0«

Software »pilot 4.0«

Software »Pilot 4.0« – is intuitive, provides an overview, and enables operators to perform reliable measurements. It offers a uniform user interface across all ZOLLER systems—including ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions. The software’s modular design allows for quick implementation of customer-specific adjustments.

Storage options—for adapter tool posts and intermediate sleeves—are available in the integrated storage compartments: for intermediate sleeves in the interior and for adapter tool posts mounted on the side. This way, you always have your accessories to hand.

With ZOLLER »﻿﻿﻿﻿»threadCheck ❘ cc﻿﻿﻿﻿,« you can measure objects non-contactly using transmitted light and incident light: Equipped with a CNC-controlled, swivelling optic carrier and transmitted and reflected light image processing, you can measure virtually anything—from cutting tools of all types to threading and Gear cutting tools—with precision and fully automatic operation.

ZOLLER Multi-sensor technology »ace« high-precision spindle

blocks.title: Multi-sensor technology
blocks.text: The centered Multi-LED ring lights on each tool ensure ideal lighting for inspections of the end face, circumference, and chip space. The optional electronic measuring sensor also offers additional measurement capabilities for threaded and Gear cutting tools.

blocks.body:
Quality management requirements are constantly increasing. That is why you need to be able to rely on the consistent measurement deviations of your machines. In ZOLLER measuring machines, length measurement errors are determined using high-precision Calibration standards made of Borofloat glass® in accordance with the DIN EN ISO 10360 standard. In accordance with this standard, at least three measurement sequences (25,326 relationships) are performed. This procedure documents the two-dimensional accuracy of ZOLLER measuring machines and ensures traceability at all times.

One-dimensional Two-dimensional

blocks.title: Two-dimensional
blocks.text: Based on DIN EN ISO 10360, Exy = 2.5 μm + (L/250 mm) μm

blocks.title: One-dimensional
blocks.text: According to VDI/VDE 2617, Ex = 1.5 μm + (L/300 mm) μm
